summary: The filing is a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting the full exercise of the over-allotment option in connection with Vogenx's initial public offering. The company sold an additional 937,500 shares at the IPO price of $13.00, adding gross proceeds of approximately $12.2 million, bringing total offering proceeds to about $93.4 million on 7.19 million shares. This is a routine post-IPO greenshoe exercise, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, or strategic event is involved. The disclosure simply confirms the mechanics of the underwriters' option and final offering size. Nothing to watch beyond standard post-IPO float and overhang considerations.
